function.name: reject_trade
function.arguments: {"public_message": "You think $300 buys you out of paying rent? Reading Railroad isn't for sale—it's the foundation of my railroad empire. You just paid tribute, Grok. Get used to it.", "private_thought": "Grok offers $300 for Reading RR after paying $25 rent. Analysis: RR cost $200, so $100 profit sounds tempting but strategically weak. Railroads scale exponentially (2 RRs = $50 rent, 3 = $100, 4 = $200). Selling now caps upside and funds a competitor. Current position: $1325 cash, strong liquidity, first mover advantage on RR monopoly. Grok has $1475, no properties—desperate to enter the game. Rejecting asserts dominance, maintains tempo control, keeps RR accumulation path open. No counter needed—straight rejection sends message: I don't negotiate from strength, I dictate terms."}
